profile.headline: Senior Java Developer | Spring Boot | Microservices | REST APIs | React | AWS
profile.summary:
I’m a hands-on Senior Java Developer with 15+ years of experience designing and building enterprise applications, Spring Boot microservices, and REST APIs.

I’m an Oracle Certified Professional Java SE 11 Developer, and my recent experience includes Java 11+, Spring Boot, microservices, event-driven systems, AWS/GCP, Docker/Kubernetes, and full-stack development with Angular and React. I also bring enterprise application-security experience with Spring Security, OAuth2, SAML2, Okta, and SSO.

I’m currently in a long-term consulting engagement and am selectively exploring fully remote Senior Java / Senior Software Engineer contract opportunities where I can contribute in a hands-on development role.

I’d be happy to discuss the position and how my background may fit your needs.

Thanks,
Anthony

positions.title: Senior Software Developer (Java) / Consultant
positions.description:
• Design and develop Java and Spring Boot applications for a large-scale internal case-processing platform supporting end-to-end, security-sensitive business workflows.
• Build and maintain RESTful microservices supporting document ingestion and digitization, payment processing, identity and address resolution, alias detection, and external verification workflows.
• Develop secure, scalable backend services for high-volume processing and integration with distributed enterprise systems and data sources.
• Implement event-driven integrations with Kafka and support cloud-native deployments on AWS using Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and GitLab CI/CD.
• Contribute to frontend modernization and integration across Angular and React applications; participate in design reviews, code reviews, troubleshooting, and production support.

positions.title: Senior Java Developer & Team Lead
positions.description:
• Designed and developed a cloud-based auto-refinancing platform with a React SPA and Java 11/Spring Boot event-driven microservices deployed to GCP and Google Kubernetes Engine through GitLab CI/CD.
• Integrated GCP Pub/Sub, PostgreSQL/Liquibase, JD Power and KBB vehicle-valuation services, RingCentral voice/SMS, and SendGrid email services.
• Implemented authentication, authorization, and SSO using Spring Security, SAML2, and Okta, including service-provider certificate and Java keystore configuration.
• Served as team lead and key contributor to Agile feature breakdown, story refinement, estimation, sprint planning, standups, retrospectives, and code reviews.

positions.title: Senior Java Developer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed components for a large-scale private mobile-content backup platform supporting major wireless carriers, including AT&T and Verizon.
• Improved photo, video, and contact-management performance and customer experience using Java 11 concurrency techniques.
• Built Java 11/Spring Boot REST microservices for AWS with Eureka service discovery and Spring Cloud Config; created Helm charts for Kubernetes deployments on Amazon EKS.
• Developed a full-stack Spring Boot/Angular application for drag-and-drop media storage in AWS S3 with CRUD operations and MongoDB metadata persistence.

positions.title: Senior Java Developer
positions.description:
• Designed cloud-based retail commerce solutions and decomposed a monolithic application into domain-driven Spring Boot microservices exposed through Spring MVC REST APIs.
• Secured services with OAuth2 Client Credentials and Authorization Code flows; implemented persistence with Spring Data JPA/Hibernate and independent database schemas.
• Implemented asynchronous JMS messaging and synchronous OpenFeign communication, with Eureka service discovery and Spring Cloud Config backed by Git.
• Implemented Spring Cloud Gateway routing and load balancing with Resilience4j circuit breakers; containerized services with Docker/Fabric8 and Docker Swarm, and centralized logs with Filebeat and the ELK stack.

positions.title: Senior Java Developer / Consultant
positions.description:
• Designed and developed Spring Boot REST and batch-processing applications for importing client, visit, claim, and provider data with complex validation and aggregation workflows.
• Implemented solutions using Spring Data, Spring Integration, Apache Camel, AMQ/RabbitMQ, Oracle, AWS archival, file decryption, and operational logging and notification.

positions.title: Senior Java Developer / Architect
positions.description:
• Designed and developed publication-workflow microservices and REST APIs using Java 8, Spring Boot, and Spring Data JPA/Hibernate; secured server-to-server communication with OAuth2 Client Credentials and Spring Security.
• Applied test-driven development with JUnit, Mockito, and Hamcrest; documented APIs with Springfox/Swagger and produced UML, test documentation, and JIRA epics and tasks for delivery planning.

positions.title: Senior Java Developer / Principal Architect
positions.description:
• Established REST API guidelines and best practices across business lines, including resource design, HTTP semantics, HATEOAS, and Swagger/OpenAPI documentation.
• Designed and developed a distributed Java/JEE business-service layer using Spring dependency injection, JPA, REST, and SOAP to provide a consistent interface across heterogeneous enterprise systems.
• Built CI/CD and container-platform capabilities using Jenkins, Git/Bitbucket, Nexus, Sonar, Docker, OpenShift, and Kubernetes; contributed to Docker image-repository practices.
• Contributed hands-on design and code for a multitenant digital-banking platform and modernization roadmap, including Keycloak SSO and ELK-based observability.
